PC POWER PP-GS2406 BK Flow Mesh Elite ATX Gaming Casing

The PC POWER PP-GS2406 BK Flow Mesh Elite ATX Gaming Casing is engineered for gamers and PC builders who value high airflow, modern aesthetics, and versatile build compatibility. Designed with a full mesh front panel, this mid-tower case enhances ventilation, making it ideal for high-performance and gaming builds. With support for ATX, Micro-ATX, and Mini-ITX motherboards, multiple storage drives, and long GPUs, it delivers both style and performance on a budget.

Whether you're building a gaming rig or a performance workstation, the Flow Mesh Elite offers excellent cooling support, cable management features, and expansion flexibility in a sleek black steel frame.

Specifications:

Model: PP-GS2406 BK Flow Mesh Elite

  • Brand: PC POWER
  • Form Factor: Mid Tower
  • Motherboard Support: ATX, Micro-ATX, Mini-ITX
  • Front Panel: Full mesh design for optimal airflow
  • Side Panel: Acrylic/Tempered-look panel (depending on region)
  • Expansion Slots:7
  • Drive Bays:2 x 3.5", 2 x 2.5"
  • Cooling Support: Up to 6 fans (Front: 3, Top: 2, Rear: 1)
  • Radiator Support: Front: up to 240mm / Rear: 120mm
  • GPU Clearance: Up to 320mm
  • CPU Cooler Clearance: Up to 160mm
  • Power Supply Support: Bottom-mounted ATX PSU (not included)
  • I/O Ports 1 x USB 3.0, 2 x USB 2.0, HD Audio, Mic
  • Material Steel body with plastic front panel
  • Color: Black
